Renee (People Ops): Mateo's I-9/background intake hit a timezone + notary snag. He's in NZT and his passport is fine, but vendor requires a certified notary for the physical document because we're doing remote verification. Day-1 currently Mon 12/02 09:00 PT. Mateo said in NZ that falls late evening and he'd prefer a start the following Tuesday.

Mateo L (candidate): Hey all 5 - I can do a local notary on Mon NZT afternoon (that's Sun PT evening). Will that let vendor clear in time? Also asked whether 401(k) enrollment applies since I'm remote NZ-based.

Priya - Background Ops: vendor needs either a video-notary session + timestamped upload or a stamped/apostilled notary certificate. Video-notary done with a vetted notary usually clears within 24h; apostille can add several days. If Mateo does video-notary Mon NZT, vendor can likely clear by Tue PT.

Renee (People Ops): Proposal: move orientation to Tue 12/03 09:00 PT / Wed 12/04 06:00 NZT to give vendor time and avoid late-night for Mateo. Mateo, can you confirm availability for video-notary on Mon 12/02 18:00 NZT?

Mateo L (candidate): Confirmed for 12/02 18:00 NZT. I'll book the local video-notary and upload the signed page + selfie during the call.

Sam (Benefits): Benefits note: international hires follow local statutory rules; 401(k) not applicable for NZ contractors. If Mateo is full-time and on US payroll, 401(k) enrollment applies, otherwise local pension rules handled by payroll. We can provide NZ-specific benefits brochure. Stipend/prorated allowances apply per policy and start date.

Hannah (Hiring Manager): We're aiming for productive ramp by mid-Dec. I approve shifting start to Tue 12/03 PT. Also approve one-time 72-hour extension to the stipend enrollment window to cover the timezone delay.

Owen - IT: I'll put the laptop on express hold under ticket IT-3322. For NZ addresses customs + local delivery could add 4-7 business days. Please DM the shipping address; don't post here.

CourierBot: Available local partner: NZ-Express. Earliest pickup for notarized docs / courier verification: 2024-12-03 10:00 NZT. Use `!book NZ-Express 2024-12-03 10:00` to reserve.
